title: Story understanding (stage 1)
description: The structured read of story.json — the first artifact a Claude session produces. Every downstream stage inherits this read; misclassification here propagates to template selection, asset choice, and quality-bar enforcement.

consumed_by: stage 2 — story_type drives which template's stage_2_extra_checks fire; who/where seed entity matching
stage 3 — core_claim + frame shape the script's load-bearing sentence
stage 4 — story_type drives the asset-hint policy; where decides whether a map module is justified
stage 5 — C20 verifies story_type matches between this artifact and the module plan

story_type.description: Picked by walking the rule list in the prompt; never improvised. Drives template selection at every later stage.

core_claim.description: One declarative present-tense sentence. No hedge words. Built from who+what+when+where with the most load-bearing facts.

who.description: Proper-cased actors. Pulled from primary_entities_enriched verbatim. 'Officials' / 'sources' are not valid entries.

what.description: A verb phrase, not a sentence. The action.

when.description: Absolute date or date range. Convert relative dates against story.row.published_at.

where.description: Place names from primary_places. Empty array is allowed but must be reflected in unknown_or_disputed.

frame.description: Editorial framing. Should mirror story.row.editorial_posture when it maps clearly.

editorial_posture.description: Mirror of story.row.editorial_posture if present, else null. Used by templates and stage-5 checks.

unknown_or_disputed.description: Items the source row explicitly does not settle. Pulled from factual_conflicts first, plus anything else stage 1 noticed (unclear timeline, missing actor identity, ambiguous causation).

notes.description: Optional free-text notes for downstream stages. Kept short.
